notes: Ludum Dare 57 Unity 3D adventure Crab with a Hook by Kettle Game Studio (https://kettle-studio.itch.io/crab-with-a-hook; https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/crab-with-a-hook). A crab uses a grappling hook and rewindable air hose to collect sea shells. Complete Unity 6000.0.26f1 project (changeset ccb7c73d2c02) with the playable game scene Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity enabled in EditorBuildSettings (the game was built in that scene, not an unused URP template). MIT at the repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2025 Kettle Game Studio); itch.io also lists the code license as MIT. Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): URP 17.0.3, uGUI 2.0.0, Input System 1.11.2, AI Navigation 2.0.4, Splines 2.6.1, Timeline 1.8.7, Visual Scripting 1.9.4, test framework, IDE packages (Rider / Visual Studio), Collab Proxy, Multiplayer Center, and built-in modules. LiberationSans (SIL Open Font License 1.1, designer Steve Matteson) is the bundled TextMesh Pro default font; LiberationSans - OFL.txt is retained. TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sprites/asset were omitted; TMP Settings.asset m_defaultSpriteAsset was cleared and m_enableEmojiSupport was set to 0; the playable scene does not require it. Unused URP template leftovers Assets/TutorialInfo/ and Assets/Readme.asset were omitted, as was editor .vscode/. Third-party fonts were omitted because they are not whitelist-redistributable OSS (scene/GUID references may remain): ALS_SPb.otf (md5 92c3a81024570768cb82617442b7cf72; name table Copyright 2014 Art Lebedev Studio, All rights reserved, commercial ALS SPb typeface by Ksenia Yerulevich) plus ALS_SPb SDF.asset; LongIslandAntiqua.ttf (md5 1bb4e31f25460668f059f512272fe8a6; name table Copyright (c) Typographer Mediengestaltung, 2000. All rights reserved) plus LongIslandAntiqua SDF.asset. Soundtrack Assets/Sounds/Music/ (1 — Underwater.mp3, 2 — Overwater.mp3, 3 — Innerwater.mp3, brapcrave.mp3) credited on itch/ldjam to Adam Arutyunov and Tigran Mamedov; SFX under Assets/Sounds/ credited to Viacheslav Ivanchenko; included under the repository MIT. Original Blender/Krita sources under Blend/ and Gamedesign/, plus painted model atlases (crab, hook, shells, pirate/ruin/sci-fi props, stylized decals and noise) retained as team art (itch credits Oleg Arutyunov with code/level art/VFX, Nicole Akopdzhanova with VFX/3D, Sergey Duyunov with 3D; itch states no generative AI was used). No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no Library/Logs/DLL, no .DS_Store, no LFS. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~114M snapshot after omissions. Claim #4127.
